privacySubtitle:
Before using Business Scanner, please read how personal data is processed.

This screen contains a summary of the main privacy information. The complete Privacy Policy, containing all details required by Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and applicable laws, is always available on the official Business Scanner website.
privacySection1: To manage activation, trial period, licensing and support, KFIVE processes certain technical and identifying data, such as email, installation or device identifier, active plan, license status and available AI quota.
privacySection2:
Photos of business cards and documents, OCR extracted data, contacts, notes, and imported PDFs are normally stored exclusively on the device.

During normal local use, KFIVE cannot access this content.
privacySection3:
When local recognition is insufficient, you can choose to use the "Ask AI for Help" feature.

Only in this case, the selected document, image, or text is transmitted online to a cloud artificial intelligence service to perform the requested processing.

KFIVE does not use this content for advertising, marketing or profiling and does not intentionally store it in its databases.

A specific warning will be shown before every transmission to the AI.
privacySection4:
You must be authorized to acquire and use the data contained in business cards and documents.

OCR and Artificial Intelligence may produce inaccurate results.
Always verify the data before saving, exporting, sharing, or using it.
privacyOpenFullPolicy: Click here to read the full Privacy Policy
